 SECTION A: MULTIPLE CHOICE QUESTIONS (40 Marks)
 Read the instructions carefully.
1. You have been given this question paper and an answer sheet. This section of the
 question paper consists of 40 multiple-choice questions.
2. Answer ALL questions on the answer sheet provided, NOT on the question paper.
3. Do all the necessary rough work on the question paper.
HOW TO USE THE ANSWER SHEET
4. Use an ordinary HB pencil.
5. Confirm that the answer sheet you have been provided with has the following:
 YOUR ASSESSMENT NUMBER
 YOUR NAME
 NAME OF YOUR SCHOOL
 NAME OF THE SUBJECT
6. Keep the answer sheet clean, dry and DO NOT fold it.
7. For each of the questions 1 – 40, four answers are given. The answers are lettered A, B, C and D.
 In each case, only ONE of the four answers is correct. Choose the correct answer.
8. On the answer sheet, mark the correct answer by drawing a dark line inside the box as shown in
 the example below.
 17. Understanding the role of colour is important for artists to effectively communicate
 their ideas.
 Which of the following best describes the role of colour as an art element?
 A. Colour is used to make artwork visually appealing.
 B. Colour helps to show emotions and mood in artworks.
 C. Colour plays a role in realistic and abstract artworks.
 D. Colour enhances the subject matter in an artwork.
 The correct answer is ‘B’.
 On the answer sheet, in the set of boxes given, draw a dark line inside the box with the
 letter C printed in it as marked below.
 [A] [B] [C] [D]
9. The dark line MUST be within the box. DO NOT make any marks outside the boxes.
10. For each question, mark ONLY ONE box.
 PART I : PERFORMING ARTS
1. Performance of a folksong involves an interaction of various components. Which of the following
 is a component of a folk song?
 A. Articulation
 B. Dynamics
 C. Instrumentation
 D. Occasion
2. Below is the first half of a four-bar rhythm:
 Which of the following options makes an appropriate second half?
3. A group of learners listened to a melody and noted the following features:
 (i) It was easy to sing.
 (ii) It was easy to dance to.
 (iii) It was easy to remember.
 (iv) It had balanced phrases.
 Which three of the above features constitute qualities a good melody?
 A. (i), (ii), (iv)
 B. (i), (iii), (iv)
 C. (ii), (iii), (iv)
 D. (i), (ii), (iii)
4. Pitch in music refers to the__________.
 A. highness or lowness of sound.
 B. layering of notes to make sound.
 C. loudness or softness of sound.
 D. quality of notes that make sound.
5. Which of the following musical terms is not correctly matched with its corresponding sign?
 A. Flat
 B. Sharp
 C. Crotchet
 D. Loud p
 Turn over
6. A learner listed the following as features of a scale in Music:
 (i) Starts on G and ends on G
 (ii) Has 3 sets of semitones
 (iii)Has a sharp on note F
 (iv) Has a total of 8 notes
 (v) Has a sharp on note G
 Which three of the features above correctly describe the scale of G major?
 A. (i), (ii), (iv)
 B. (i), (iii), (v)
 C. (i), (ii), (v)
 D. (i), (iii), (iv)
7. Zedo performed a Kenyan folksong for assessment. The teacher noticed that his voice could not
 be heard properly. Which vocal technique did Zedo have a problem with?
 A. Expression
 B. Projection
 C. Diction
 D. Phrasing
8. Learners tapped the rhythm below while reciting its corresponding French rhythm names:
 Which of the following are the French rhythm names that the learners recited?
 A. Ta-te taa taa ta-te taa ta-te taa taa taa
 B. Taa ta-te taa ta-te ta-te taa taa taa taa
 C. Taa ta-te taa taa ta-te ta-te taa taa taa
 D. Ta-te taa taa ta-te ta-te taa taa taa taa
9. Study the diagram of the keyboard below and answer the question that follows.
 Identify the notes marked X and Y respectively.
 A. D and B flat
 B. D and A flat
 C. D sharp and B
 D. D flat and A sharp
10. Creative Arts and Sports play various roles in society. Which of the following is not their social
 role?
 A. To promote unity
 B. To create employment
 C. To preserve culture
 D. To promote patriotism
11. During a music lesson, Grade 7 learners tapped various rhythms. They incorporated three of the
 aspects below except __________
 A. Beat
 B. Duration
 C. Interval
 D. Tempo
12. Which of the following notes is correctly matched with its rest?
 A. Semibreve -
 B. Minim -
 C. Crotchet -
 D. Quaver -
13. Which of the following is not a component of a story?
 A. Backdrop
 B. Plot
 C. Setting
 D. Theme
14. Mzee Mulwa was invited to tell a story to Grade 7 learners. His story had the following:
 (i) a sad song
 (ii) a clear plot
 (iii) a happy ending
 (iv) a funny character
 Which of the characteristics is a quality of a good story?
 A. (iii)
 B. (i)
 C. (iv)
 D. (ii)
15. A Persona in a verse is ___________
 A. the character in the verse.
 B. the performer of the verse.
 C. the setting in the verse.
 D. the writer of the verse
 5 Turn over
16. Mima used a song while telling a story to her fellow learners. Identify the role that the song
 played in this story.
 A. It lengthened duration of the story
 B. It engaged the audience in the story
 C. It identified the culture of the audience
 D. It made the audience to dance
PART II: SPORTS
17. Four learners performed races as shown in the table below:
 Abdi 400 meters
 Amos 800 meters
 Amani 200 metres
 Ann 100 meters
 Who among the four learners performed a middle-distance race?
 A. Ann
 B. Amani
 C. Amos
 D. Abdi
18. The following are steps followed during a Javelin throwing activity.
 (i) Throwing.
 (ii) Aiming.
 (iii) Standing position.
 (iv) Following through.
 Which is the correct order of performing the activity?
 A. (ii) (iii) (iv) (i)
 B. (iii) (ii) (i) (iv)
 C. (ii) (iv) (i) (iii)
 D. (iii) (i) (ii) (iv)
19. The main reason why learners engage in sports activities is to _____
 A. develop teamwork through group activities.
 B. learn rules of the various games.
 C. maintain a healthy life through physical fitness.
 D. promote body growth and development.
20. In a game of football, players shoot when they__________________
 A. are under pressure to score from the defenders.
 B. are under pressure to score from their teammates.
 C. have the ball and near the goal.
 D. have the ball and an opportunity to score.
21. When practising the skill of passing the ball in Handball, the captain asked the team to:
 (i) Stand with their feet shoulder-width apart;
 (ii) Hold the ball with both hands and spread the fingers;
 (iii)Bring the ball to the side near the hip and bend the elbows;
 (iv) Swing arms backwards and then forward, then pass the ball.
 The type of pass performed by the team is_________________________
 A. flick pass.
 B. front pass.
 C. jump pass.
 D. side pass.
22. During a lesson, learners watched a video clip showing a 1500 meters race. They observed that
 the race is a _______.
 A. Relay race where teams of four athletes run equal distance.
 B. long-distance race where athletes run 25 laps on a field.
 C. middle-distance race where athletes run for 3.75 laps on a field.
 D. short-distance race where athletes run on a straight section of the field.
23. Volleying is one of the basic skills used in a game of volleyball. The following are steps followed
 when performing a volley.
 i. Stand with feet shoulder with apart
 ii. Positioning the hands
 iii. Follow through
 iv. Transfer bodyweight
 v. Contact the ball
 Which of the following is correct order of the steps?
 A. (i), (ii), (iii), (iv), (v)
 B. (i), (ii), (v), (iv), (iii)
 C. (v), (iv), (iii), (ii), (i)
 D. (iv), (ii), (i), (v), (iii)
24. A Grade 9 teacher advised the learners to practice the skill of tripple jump. Which of the following
 options shows the correct arrangement of the steps followed when performing triple jump?
 A. Approach, flight, take-off, landing.
 B. Approach, take-off, flight, landing.
 C. Approach, landing, flight, take-off.
 D. Approach, flight, landing, take-off.
25. A Grade 9 sports teacher introduced the skill of kicking in the game of rugby. The teacher asked
 the learners to demonstrate the kicks as follows:
 i. Juma – Place kick
 ii. Zubeida – Punt kick
 iii. Amani – drop kick
 iv. Zawadi – grubber kick
 Turn over
Which learner demonstrated the kick that is performed by releasing the ball and kicking it before it
touches the ground?
 A. Juma
 B. Zawadi
 C. Zubeida
 D. Amani
26. During the interschool Basketball competitions, Kiptanui was declared the best player of the
 year. The teammates hugged him and sung songs in celebration. The teammates
 showed___________.
 A. Love.
 B. Honesty.
 C. Integrity.
 D. Responsibility.
27. Grade 8 learners were put in groups of five. Each group was asked to discuss fair play in sports.
 Which of the following could they have discussed?
 A. Competition and responsibility.
 B. Tolerance and respect.
 C. Respect and contest.
 D. Competition and tolerance
28. During a sports lesson, learners explained reasons why they should not use drugs to help them
 improve performance. Which of the following is the BEST reason given by leaners?
 A. Drug gives advantage to the performer.
 B. Drug use leads to wastage of money.
 C. Drug use leads to lateness in school.
 D. Drug use leads to poor performance in academics.
PART III: VISUAL ARTS
29. Nimo researched on the components of 2D visual arts with focus on the concept of positive space.
 In art, positive space refers to ____________________.
 A. the area below the objects.
 B. the area surrounding objects.
 C. the area occupied by objects.
 D. the depth created by overlapping objects.
30. A group of Learners were discussing on various types of balance found in artworks. Which type
 of balance has elements equally distributed on either side of a vertical axis?
 A. Symmetrical
 B. Asymmetrical
 C. Informal
 D. Radial
31. Looking at the artwork below, what artistic principle is demonstrated?
 A. Contrast
 B. Balance
 C. Harmony
 D. Rhythm
32. A group of learners designed their school’s new badge. They mixed a primary colour with an
 adjacent secondary colour. What was the resultant colour?
 A. Warm colour
 B. Tertiary colour
 C. Intermediate colour
 D. Complementary colour
33. During a class discussion on the principles of design in art, Roni asked why a focal point is
 important in an artwork. What answer would you give Roni?
 A. It creates a sense of balance.
 B. It attracts the viewer's attention.
 C. It adds complexity to the artwork.
 D. It determines the texture of the artwork.
34. Analyse the reproduction below of a type of drawing.
 Choose the type of drawing it represents.
 A. Landscape drawing
 B. Nature drawing
 C. Portrait drawing
 D. Still life drawing
 Turn over
35. Which one of the following options correctly defines objects that have length, width and height.
 A. Texture
 B. Shape
 C. Form
 D. Value
36. Which one of the techniques in the options is used in creating wooden sculptures?
 A. Casting
 B. Carving
 C. Modelling
 D. Assembling
37. A set designer has used a blue couch for a scene. Which colour should the costume of a character
 sitting on the couch be to attract the most attention?
 A. Red
 B. Green
 C. Yellow
 D. Orange
38. Look at the sculpture below.
 How many dimensions does it have?
 A. One
 B. Two
 C. Three
 D. Four
39. A company requires sequence of drawings for an energy drink where an athlete takes a sip.
 Which term refers to each image in the sequence of drawing?
 A. Design
 B. Frame
 C. Story idea
 D. Animation
40. You are in the process of printing on fabric using one colour. Why is it important to make
 registration marks on the fabric before printing?
 A. To align the pattern.
 B. To scale the artwork.
 C. To align the colours
 D. To enhance artwork.
